title: A TV client that authorizes every media request can use an OIDC device-authorization grant and a QR code
notes: Rejected for JS-039 because no supported client calls it: unmodified Jellyfin TV apps draw Quick Connect's code, and Jellyfin's own grant no jellyscale work makes Octave use. Promote when a client that authorizes every media request draws a QR or ships the device-authorization grant; it then returns as a brief. D-083: the grant is rejected as a protocol; the QR outcome is BL-229.
